name: Glyphic Parchment
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Glyphic Parchment points young mages toward their first lessons. Gornek delivers the runed notice, which sends them to Mai'ah near the Den to begin learning the arcane.

sections.title: A Summons to Study
sections.body: New recruits test their strength against Durotar's local pests, but those drawn to magic need more than brute force. Gornek passes along a notice marked with runes. It directs novice spellcasters to Mai'ah, who guides the Horde's newest recruits through their first lessons in magic.

sections.title: The Way of the Arcane
sections.body: Mai'ah waits just outside the Den, where she teaches young spellweavers to temper ambition with patience and thought. She urges them to choose their moment instead of hurling raw sorcery without care. In her lessons, novices learn to weave delicate strands of the cosmos rather than unleash an unruly tempest.

faq.answer: Mai'ah sends the parchment, and Gornek hands it to you. The mage trainer waits near the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Mai'ah waits just outside the Den in the Valley of Trials, Durotar, alongside the other class mentors.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The parchment introduces novice mages to their trainer. Speaking with Mai'ah begins your formal arcane instruction and opens the way to new spells and foundational training.

faq.q: What is Mai'ah's philosophy on magic?
faq.answer: Mai'ah teaches that arcane magic calls for intellect, restraint, and patience. A mage watches carefully, then responds at the right moment.

faq.q: Why is a troll training mages in the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: The Valley of Trials welcomes young orcs and Darkspear trolls into the Horde. Darkspear spellcasters such as Mai'ah teach their knowledge of cosmic forces to emerging mages.

faq.q: Who delivers the parchment to the player?
faq.answer: Gornek, the trial overseer at the Valley of Trials' central camp, gives you the parchment when you return to him during your early duties.

angles.text: As a mage, this missive sends you to Mai'ah to begin your studies and expand your spellbook.
As a member of the Horde, you learn that the Valley of Trials cultivates even volatile arts like the arcane with discipline, to strengthen the Horde's future.
As a troll, you can look to Mai'ah and the Darkspear's growing arcane traditions. She shares her understanding of cosmic forces with fellow trolls and allied recruits.
